test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) OJ – HC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb3a18c70d34b1fc085a33cda0fd3d2bdc7af3999f24b03730df606dd2116673.png] 

Option 2) YT – RN

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e4baf26c1017fb30d2de735787d7f5970dbbdbc1da3283f5f02efe861a0e5ad.png] 

Option 3) NI – GB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/734a505bb17d47031402ae9a4249108882467b8d8b2a2c499fd7fe24d79b1451.png] 

Option 4) KF – DY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed4964ff7a980bb298edad3493f103f6db3719e483ed16b3574c31e8a0c5d6fc.png] 

Thus, out of all 'YT – RN' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
